items.title: Implement packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts with parallelism, manifest reading, and --tag/--select filters
items.context: Create packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts (TS source) + ensure its dist artifact builds. Behavior: scan `packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts` (or a manifest-configured list); spawn each smoke as `node packages/main/dist/tasks/<name>-smoke.js` in a worker pool (default size = os.cpus().length, overridable via --jobs N); per-smoke timeout from the manifest (default 60s); aggregate exit codes (fail if ANY smoke fails); print per-smoke `PASS`/`FAIL` lines + `<n>/<m> passed in <duration>s` summary; support `--tag <tag>` to run only smokes whose manifest entry contains <tag>; support `--select <substring>` to run only smokes whose name contains <substring>; do NOT touch any existing test:* script; do NOT modify any existing smoke file. Acceptance: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select run-all-smokes` runs only its own self-smoke; `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --tag fast` filters by tag. Build (tsc) passes.
items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select <something>` prints PASS/FAIL per smoke + aggregate summary; running it without filters runs all 153 smokes in parallel and aggregates.

happy.desc: Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select run-all-smokes` -> exits 0, stdout contains PASS line for run-all-smokes-smoke and summary line matching passed in; WHY: confirms runner can discover+execute a single smoke via --select and produce aggregate output

Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --tag fast` -> exits 0, only smokes tagged fast in manifest appear in output; WHY: confirms --tag filter reads manifest tags and restricts execution set

Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js` with no filters -> spawns all 153 discovered smokes, prints per-smoke PASS/FAIL lines, prints summary like 153/153 passed in Ns; WHY: confirms full unfiltered run with directory-scan discovery
Run `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/main/tsconfig.json` -> exits 0; WHY: confirms the new run-all-smokes.ts compiles without type errors

edge.desc: Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select ZZZZZ_NONEXISTENT` -> exits 0, summary shows 0/0 passed; WHY: empty result set from --select should not crash or report failure
Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --jobs 1 --select run-all-smokes` -> exits 0 with same PASS/FAIL result as default parallelism; WHY: serial execution must not change correctness
Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --jobs 8 --select run-all-smokes` -> exits 0; WHY: parallelism exceeding cpu count should degrade gracefully, not crash
Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --tag missing-tag-xyz` -> exits 0, summary shows 0 smokes run; WHY: nonexistent tag should yield empty passing run, not error

adversarial.desc: Verify existing 153 smoke files byte-identical to main: `git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts -- :!packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts | wc -l` -> 0; WHY: runner must NOT modify any existing smoke file
Verify intent-coverage.ts still exists: `test -f packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts && echo EXISTS` -> EXISTS; WHY: always-on guard against cross-cutting infrastructure deletion
Verify dev-cli.ts still exists: `test -f packages/main/src/verifier/dev-cli.ts && echo EXISTS` -> EXISTS; WHY: always-on guard against cross-cutting infrastructure deletion

Inject deliberate-fail fixture (echo process.exit(1) to tmpdir/bad-smoke.js), run runner with that dir as scan root -> runner exits non-zero and stdout contains FAIL; WHY: runner must propagate child non-zero exit, never swallow failures
Compare `--jobs 1` vs `--jobs 4` for same --select: both produce identical PASS count on stdout; WHY: parallelism level must not change pass/fail correctness

items.title: Create packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (initial manifest with default entries) and add `test:all` npm script at root
items.context: Create packages/main/smoke-manifest.json. Schema: a JSON object with a `smokes` array; each entry has `name` (file basename without -smoke.ts), optional `tags` (string array), optional `timeoutMs` (number), optional `skip` (boolean). For B1, populate it with a small initial set covering the runner's self-smoke and 2-3 well-known fast smokes (e.g. gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke, the lab description smoke); leave the rest discoverable by directory scan (default behavior when no manifest entry exists). Add to root package.json: `"test:all": "node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js"`. The 262 existing test:* entries stay untouched. Acceptance: `npm run test:all --select run-all-smokes-smoke` runs the new runner's self-smoke; `cat packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | python3 -m json.tool` parses; root package.json has the new entry.
items.userSees: `npm run test:all` runs every smoke + reports aggregate; existing `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` (etc.) still works byte-identical.

items.title: Add the runner's self-smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts
items.context: Create packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts that verifies the runner: (a) correctly detects a known-PASSING fixture smoke as PASS; (b) correctly detects a deliberate-FAIL fixture smoke as FAIL; (c) honors --tag filtering (running with --tag missing-tag returns 0 smokes); (d) honors --select filtering; (e) honors --jobs N parallelism (run with --jobs 1 vs --jobs 4, both pass). The fixtures can be inline JS strings the smoke writes to a tmpdir + invokes the runner with a config pointing at them. Standalone-runnable: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js`. Add `"test:run-all-smokes-smoke": "node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js"` to packages/main/package.json. Acceptance: the self-smoke exits 0 when the runner behaves correctly; if you deliberately break the runner (e.g. swallow a child's non-zero exit), the self-smoke fails with a clear pointer.
items.userSees: `npm run test:run-all-smokes-smoke` exits 0 on HEAD; injecting a runner bug makes it fail with a specific assertion message.
